desc:
[beta] ZOO or OOF 2! 🦓💥

The animals are on the loose again!

🐾 Play as an Animal and escape the zoo.
🔍 Play as a Zookeeper and catch them before they get away.
🎮 Explore different gamemodes, maps, and challenges.
🌳 Unlock new animals, skins, and rewards as you play.

Will it be a clean escape… or a massive OOF?

⭐ Like and favorite the game!
🔔 Enable notifications for updates and events!
👥 Join our group to stay connected!

🧸 All weapons are fictional, and the animals are harmless dummies. It’s all just fun!
